note: Tellico Reservoir Development Agency campground on a point in Tellico Lake near Greenback. Three loops of wooded and lakefront sites; the outer ring of the east-point loop sits on open grass a few metres above the lake. Swim beach, boat ramp, docks and rental boat slips; gated entrance with a resident manager. --Claude
